name: jian_zhi_(gesture)
translation: 剑指（武术手型：食指与中指伸直并拢，拇指压在无名指与小指上）
source: International Wushu Federation, 2023 Taolu Group A judging guide (CN/EN), p.8, lists 剑指 / Jiàn Zhǐ (Sword Fingers) and specifies the finger/thumb positions: https://iwuf.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/TAOLU-GROUP-A-EN-CN.pdf. Gelbooru sample posts 13541014, 13525628, 13525623, 13524020 tag the gesture in Chinese martial/sword-character art.

name: deva_(digimon)
translation: 十二神将（《数码宝贝》中的Deva Digimon群体标签）
source: Official Digimon Encyclopedia profile for Vajramon states it is one of the Twelve Deva Digimon: https://digimon.net/reference_en/detail.php?directory_name=vajramon. Gelbooru post 14723731 tags deva_(digimon) together with the 12 Deva names; this is the group, not the Four Sovereigns or a single Deva.

name: cat_burglar
translation: 飞贼（攀墙或翻窗入室行窃的盗贼）
source: Cambridge English Dictionary defines cat burglar as a thief who enters a building by climbing walls to an upper window/door, and gives the Chinese gloss （翻墙入户的）盗贼，飞贼: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/cat-burglar. Gelbooru sample posts 14268310 (Jackie Chan Adventures) and 5307462/5307460 (Lupin III) use the thief/character trope; the tag does not mean stealing cats.

name: hyper_pregnancy
translation: 夸张孕肚题材（以明显膨大的孕肚为视觉表现，不等同于妊娠进程加速）
source: Checked the first 35 visible Gelbooru result previews for hyper_pregnancy (frozen Gel count=62): 35/35 also tag pregnant, 33/35 tag big_belly, none tag rapid_pregnancy; sampled posts include 15241875, 14942162, 14620821, 14493587. The evidence points to exaggerated pregnancy/belly imagery, not rapid pregnancy as a process.

name: the_forester_"which_girl"_(meme)
translation: 《The Forester》（1910年鉴）“Which Girl?”插图梗图（源自C. D. Gibson《The Weaker Sex》）
source: Danbooru wiki exact tag indicates this old tag moved to the_weaker_sex_1_(gibson); current page id=184139 describes C. D. Gibson's 1903 illustration and the 1910 Lake Forest University yearbook reprint captioned “Which Girl?” with “With Apologies to C. D. Gibson”, later viral as a meme: https://danbooru.donmai.us/wiki_pages/184139. Flickr/Internet Archive Book Images identifies the scan as page 128 of The Forester (1910) and transcribes the “THE 1910 FORESTER WHICH GIRL?” caption: https://www.flickr.com/photos/internetarchivebookimages/14742876486. Gelbooru exact post search shows the currently used canonical tag on post 15232854: https://gelbooru.com/index.php?page=post&s=view&id=15232854.
